 Cameron Fens By the Numbers
 UNC center Cameron Fens was granted a waiver to play this basketball season, so here is his game by the numbers from his college career to this point.
 Andrew Jones VIP 3 
 CHAPEL HILL - Cameron Fens is finally eligible to play basketball at North Carolina after he was granted a medical waiver on Thursday in a court in Orange County, NC.
 Fens is a 7-foot, 255-pound transfer from South Dakota, where he played the previous two seasons. His first two campaigns were at Illinois-Chicago.
 Fens committed to UNC as a transfer in August after high school class of 2022 athletes were granted a waiver for a fifth season, but his case was eventually reversed and got tied up in the Tennessee court system.
